cases.exposure_context_quote: A 24-year-old male farmer was brought to the emergency department after voluntarily consuming 100 mL of ACCOUNT (Novaluron 5.25% + Indoxacarb 4.5%) diluted in a soft carbonated beverage.
cases.agent: ACCOUNT (Novaluron 5.25% + Indoxacarb 4.5%), 100 mL diluted in a soft carbonated beverage
cases.agent_quote: voluntarily consuming 100 mL of ACCOUNT (Novaluron 5.25% + Indoxacarb 4.5%) diluted in a soft carbonated beverage
cases.circumstance: intentional ingestion in a suicide attempt

symptoms.finding: methemoglobinemia (75.16%) with cyanosis/bluish discolouration of buccal mucosa and hypoxia (SpO2 84% on 14 L/min oxygen)
symptoms.quote: The patient was shifted to the intensive care unit and tested for methaemoglobin levels, which were 11.3 g/dL (75.16 %).

symptoms.finding: tachypnoea with intercostal retractions, tachycardia 110 bpm
symptoms.quote: He was afebrile, with a pulse of 110 beats/min and regular rhythm, a respiratory rate of 30 breaths/min, blood pressure of 130/70 mm Hg in the right arm in the supine position and an oxygen saturation of 84% on 14 L/min of oxygen via a non-rebreather mask.

symptoms.finding: minimal bilateral pleural effusions on HRCT chest
symptoms.quote: High-resolution computed tomography of the chest revealed minimal bilateral pleural effusions (right greater than left) with no consolidations.

cases.time_to_care: UNVERIFIED (received gastric lavage at a nearby hospital before transfer)

labs.name: methaemoglobin
labs.quote: A repeat methaemoglobin level decreased to 3.8%.

labs.name: arterial blood gas
labs.value: pH 7.45, pCO2 39 mm Hg, pO2 89 mm Hg, sO2 100%
labs.quote: Arterial blood gas (ABG) analysis showed a pH of 7.45, pCO2 of 39 mm Hg, pO2 of 89 mm Hg and sO2 of 100%.

labs.name: other laboratory results
labs.quote: Other laboratory results were within normal limits.

treatment.name: gastric lavage at nearby hospital
treatment.quote: He had received gastric lavage at a nearby hospital before being transferred to our centre.

treatment.name: methylene blue 100 mg diluted in 5% dextrose over 30 min
treatment.quote: A 100 mg injection of methylene blue diluted in 5% dextrose was administered over 30 min.

cases.outcome: survived; bluish discolouration resolved next day, SpO2 95% on room air, discharged the following day after transfer to general ward
cases.outcome_quote: The bluish discolouration of the buccal mucosa completely disappeared the next day, and oxygen saturation improved to 95% on room air. A repeat methaemoglobin level decreased to 3.8%. The patient was transferred to the general ward and discharged the following day.
